name: AnnePad
notes: Manifest owned by the game repository (steps around its existing scripts; ROM read at build time).

commands: brew install cmake ninja mips-linux-gnu-binutils jq ripgrep sdl2

steps: Open {file} and move AnnePad.app to your Applications folder.
Open AnnePad and choose your own Pokémon Stadium (US) ROM with Change ROM. Keep Homebrew's sdl2 installed: AnnePad uses it.
Updating? Replace the old AnnePad.app with the new one. Your saves are kept.
